documentation: Feature 021 feature-spec.md and relevant architecture guidance

source_inspections_before_clarification.question: How does a horizontal marker describe a three-column supplier block including its hidden item-name column?
source_inspections_before_clarification.missing_from_guide: The guide demonstrates single-column and nested dimensions but does not explicitly specify that every adjacent column in a multi-column block needs the same geometry marker.
source_inspections_before_clarification.answer: Place $h(1) in each of the three adjacent top control cells; each block is one horizontal tuple.

source_inspections_before_clarification.question: How do repeated lot headers, detail rows and subtotal footers form one region?
source_inspections_before_clarification.missing_from_guide: The guide shows level-1/2/1 markers but does not fully specify contiguous control runs or header/body/footer interval ownership.
source_inspections_before_clarification.answer: Use one contiguous level-1/level-2/level-1 control run; data input order supplies group ancestry.

source_inspections_before_clarification.question: How can full warnings and generated workbook bytes be retained over REST?
source_inspections_before_clarification.missing_from_guide: The XLSX guide does not document REST multipart negotiation. Feature 021 documents it; source inspection was avoidable using that document and live OpenAPI.
source_inspections_before_clarification.answer: Accept multipart/mixed; retain workbook and diagnostics.json.

source_inspections_before_clarification.question: Which installed Open XML SDK version can validate source and outputs without new dependencies?
source_inspections_before_clarification.missing_from_guide: The XLSX guide is not a dependency inventory.
source_inspections_before_clarification.answer: Use installed DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.5.1 and net10.0; no engine behavior consulted.
